description: REQ-AUTH-004 line 161 states 'Requests with absent Origin header: behavior depends on deployment (same-origin browser requests will have no Origin)'. This is ambiguous and fails to specify a concrete behavior. The source spec 2weeks-spec.md line 144 says all Cookie-linked APIs (including GET /v1/auth/discord/session) use FRONTEND_BASE_URL as the only permitted Origin. T-P0-01 (tdd-acceptance-matrix-mvp.md line 50) requires 'Cookie連携API (GET /v1/auth/discord/session) の許可Originが FRONTEND_BASE_URL 固定でない' as a Red criterion. The behavioral spec should either mandate 403 for absent Origin (matching POST endpoints) or explicitly state that absent Origin is allowed for GET /v1/auth/discord/session with a source-spec justification for the asymmetry.

evidence.snippet: - Requests with absent `Origin` header: behavior depends on deployment (same-origin browser requests will have no Origin)

sourceReference: 2weeks-spec.md line 144: shared Origin policy for all Cookie-linked APIs; tdd-acceptance-matrix-mvp.md line 50: T-P0-01 Red criterion
recommendation: Replace the ambiguous statement with a concrete decision. Given that the source spec line 144 includes GET /v1/auth/discord/session in the same Origin policy as POST endpoints, the safest choice is to mandate 403 for absent Origin. If absent Origin should be allowed for same-origin GET requests, document the rationale as a Change Request against the shared policy.
